figP1_participant_groups: Participant groups in the discovery download (1300 people), kept separate. Only the blue group has remission labels. Other discovery people are NOT assumed healthy and have no remission label; 1129 non-rTMS people have both EC and EO recordings (candidate reference pool, not yet a validated one). Replication sets (104 + 60 recordings) have zero ID overlap with discovery or the workbook and are not shown or used. Fingerprint check: 0 identical files across sets; 2 healthy people have identical ses-1/ses-2 EC files (not in the labeled cohort).
figP2_cleaning_examples: Cleaning comparison for three fixed-rule examples (first ID in each outcome-blind QC stratum with v2 status ok; IDs not shown). Left: raw (padding trimmed, demeaned), v1 and v2 cleaned traces (uV). Middle: mean scalp PSD. Right: relative eigenvalue spectrum of the cleaned 26-channel covariance (steep falloff = rank loss from ICA removal/interpolation, which affects covariance-ratio features). Neither pipeline is ground truth; agreement between them does not prove artifact removal.
figP3_removed_components: Evidence for components removed by the corrected (v2) pipeline in the same three examples: scalp topography of each removed independent component (arbitrary sign), maximum absolute EOG correlation |r| (candidates are components whose correlation is an outlier, z>3, among all components of that recording) and frontal-dominance ratio (mean |weight| at Fp1/Fp2/F7/F8 over all channels; rule: outlier and ratio>=1.5, ranked by |r|, max 3). The frontal-ratio rule is crude: for example the third component of Example 2 has a diffuse, non-blink-like map yet passes, so these exclusions need visual review before any claim of artifact removal. v1 removed components by index order (see table in the report).
figP4_v1_v2_summary: Outcome-blind comparison of original (v1) and corrected (v2) cleaning over all 328 included recordings. Left: components removed. Middle: recording status (v2: 17 ICA fits that hit the iteration limit were retried once; 8 still failed and are missing, not silently kept). Right: per-feature agreement across 164 patients between the two cleaning views of the same recordings (dot = one feature). Power features agree almost perfectly; FAA and connectivity depend more on cleaning (lowest r 0.70). No outcome labels were used here.
